content_owner_id.description: Used only for Content Owner reports. The ID of the content owner for whom the API request is being made.

report_type.description: The name of report of which connector will sync the data.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Youtube client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Youtube client application.

client_access.description: External client credentials to access the connector source.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
